# Fixed 65,536-point FFT plan

The production radix-2 FFT now creates one immutable, thread-safe 65,536-point plan and reuses it for all forward and inverse transforms. The plan precomputes exactly the same bit-reversal swap pairs used by the reference implementation and separate forward/inverse cosine and sine tables using the reference angle expressions. Butterfly order, arithmetic order, inverse normalization, FFT length, Forward FFT sharing, seven band masks, per-band inverse FFT, Harmonic synthesis, and all later DSP remain unchanged. Separate forward and inverse tables avoid deriving inverse values by sign flipping. Non-65,536 power-of-two transforms and Bluestein convolution retain the original reference radix-2 path. A translated equivalence test verified bit-identical forward and inverse outputs across multiple radix-2 sizes.
